The Finance team is where numbers become decisions. We are a high-trust team embedded in the business rather than reporting from the sidelines, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for both rigour and clarity.

About these roles

We are hiring six Finance interns for the Winter 2027 cohort, one on each of six teams. This single posting covers all six.

How to apply. Read the six tracks below, then tell us in the application form which one you prefer. Our recruiting team routes your application to that team's hiring manager. Pick the track you are most interested in and best prepared for. You do not need experience across all six areas, and we are not expecting it. If a second track appeals to you, name it as a second choice and we will consider you for both. We are less interested in whether you have done this exact work before than in how you think, how you ask questions, and what you do when the numbers do not tie.

Choose your track

Accounting & Financial Reporting. Every month, this team turns everything that happened across the company into a set of financial results, and stands behind every number in them. Inside a monthly close where every step has a deadline, you would prepare accrual and other entries needed that make a period complete. You would reconcile our corporate bank accounts and reconcile balances between our own legal entities. You would work on various projects to help continuously level up close processes, with the help of AI. You would also prepare balance sheet reconciliations in FloQast, our close software, and write the summary that explains what moved and why. This role is a strong fit for a CPA student or someone actively working toward the designation.

Brokerage Finance. This team reports the results for the regulated entities behind the products clients trade on: stocks and options, crypto, lending, and self-directed investing. Every trade, every crypto transfer, and every dollar of interest has to land accurately, and this team owns that. You would help record revenue from trading and crypto commissions, management fees, currency exchange, and interest, and reconcile client cash, securities, and crypto positions against what banks and custodians say we hold, chasing down anything that does not match by the next business day. You would also help prepare the data behind the filings our regulator requires, including the monthly and annual reports that show the brokerage holds enough capital. A single term on this team puts you close to clearing houses, market pricing, and a regulated capital calculation.

Internal Controls. Internal controls is how we know our reporting stays accurate as the company grows. We do not run the controls ourselves. The teams that own each process do, and we test that they are working, across the key processes that matter most to the financial statements. You would help test controls and gather the evidence, walk through processes with the people who run them, draw the flowcharts and write the narratives that explain how a process works, support the quarterly cycle where process owners confirm their controls execution, and help prepare the internal controls update that goes to the Audit Committee, and supports external audits, and testing activities to ensure deadlines are met.  Wealthsimple is building this program to the ‘best practice’ standard, so you would see it while it is being designed rather than after it has settled.

Finance Operations (Procure-to-Pay). Most of what Wealthsimple spends with third parties runs through this team, from the moment someone asks for something to the moment the vendor gets paid, so it works with almost every team in the company. You would help people bring a purchase through Zip, our intake software, onboard new vendors, and move a request along when it needs a Legal, Security, Privacy, or vendor-risk review. On the payments side you would work alongside Accounts Payable to match invoices against the purchase order, code them to the right team and account, and route them for approval in Zip. You would also help more of our spend run through an approved purchase order before the invoice arrives, which is what makes spend visible before it is committed , and report on where requests slow down. High volume, high visibility, and a real seat in a process being rebuilt while it runs.

Treasury: Debt Capital Markets. Treasury owns the balance sheet: our cash, how we fund the business, how much capital we hold, and our exposure to interest rates. On the debt capital markets side you would support our credit facilities and other borrowing, tracking the limits, the conditions attached to them, renewals, and the reporting that goes to our lenders. You would also help model & forecast various scenarios and their potential impact to our funding. A rare look at capital markets work from inside a company rather than across a trading desk.

You would research current and potential banking partners, prepare analysis for negotiations, sit in on those conversations, and help track how each partnership is performing. You would also help build the tools and processes we use to monitor financial risks, including foreign exchange and interest-rate exposures. A hands-on look at how a fintech negotiates partnerships, manages risk, and turns a commercial agreement into a working product.

You'll assist in bringing machine learning expertise directly to our portfolio companies' most pressing challenges, helping them build and scale potentially transformative AI products. You'll also contribute to our investment process technical diligence, helping us identify innovative and technically sound companies.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN & DELIVER



 - Support AI system development. Assist in building LLM agents, Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and fine‑tuned domain‑specific models under guidance; help implement workflows with frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex/PydanticAI.

 - Contribute to portfolio projects. Support Georgian "strike teams" embedded in portfolio companies; assist with code implementation, testing, and documentation.

 - Technical analysis & documentation. Help convert technical concepts into clear documentation; support preparation of demos and presentations for stakeholders.

 - Hands‑on R&D support. Assist in rapid prototyping, run experiments and ablation studies, contribute to internal tech notes and documentation.

 - Support AI roadmap development. Help gather requirements in discovery workshops, assist in documenting technical specifications and implementation plans.

 - Contribute to safety & governance. Assist in implementing evaluation pipelines and testing frameworks to keep models reliable and compliant.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR




IDEAL ATTRIBUTES

 - Education & Experience: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline with a focus on machine learning, optimization theory, or related areas.

 - Hands-On Foundation: Familiarity with deep learning toolkits such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Understanding of GenAI, LLM tooling and Context Engineering fundamentals.

 - Software Development: Proficiency in Python and foundational software development skills, enabling you to write clean, efficient code.

 - Problem Formulation & Communication: The ability to understand applied research problems, assist in designing experiments, implement solutions, and clearly document findings for diverse audiences with varying technical backgrounds.

 - Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work on team projects, collaborate effectively with technical groups, and communicate progress to mentors and stakeholders.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience contributing to open-source AI/ML-related projects or research papers.

 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) for MLOps and model deployment.

 - Exposure to specific industry verticals relevant to Georgian's portfolio (e.g., vertical SaaS, cybersecurity, healthcare tech, fintech).




CULTURAL ATTRIBUTES WE LOVE



 - High ambition & agency: You're allergic to incrementalism and thrive in low‑structure, high‑ownership settings.

 - Insatiable curiosity: You debug the root cause and ask why until everyone else gets annoyed—in a good way.

 - Team over ego: You amplify colleagues and founders alike, seeing leverage in elevating the collective.

 - Commercial storytelling: You speak with brevity and distill complexity so a time‑starved CEO instantly sees value.




HIRING PROCESS



We don't hire like a MAG7 or scale up — in fact we rarely hire compared to them.



You shouldn't expect a cookie-cutter high-volume hiring process with us — but a more boutique one that allows you to see a lot of the organization before joining us.



We build a thesis in what an individual brings to our very small team, versus simply matching qualifications:

 1. 30‑min intro (values & motivations)

 2. 60‑min technical interview (ML fundamentals & problem‑solving)

 3. Project discussion with team members




POSITION STATUS

 

This posting represents an active, future internship vacancy on our team. We will be interviewing for this role in the fall.

 


OUR COMMITMENT TO ACCESSIBILITY



Georgian is dedicated to building an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We provide reasonable accommodations throughout our recruitment process to ensure every candidate has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any specific accommodations at any stage, please reach out to us at peopleteam [at]  georgian.io.




USE OF AI



Innovation is at our core and we use artificial intelligence (AI) to support parts of our hiring process, such as screening and evaluating applications. We regularly review our AI tools to help promote fairness and reduce the risk of unintended bias.
